scope: Model/editor rewrite review for Lessons 0014–0020 after activity-variety, load, naturalness and skill-mix revisions; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: What time?, At six. and the shorter Six. are natural in a context where the next walk is already established.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Learner-facing Persian preserves the intended meaning and now uses «بخش» instead of the hamza-bearing «جزء», matching Nova orthography rules without changing the task.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The first clock-time Lesson intentionally uses only one new clock number instead of teaching six and seven together.

distractorQuality.evidence: The schedule task contrasts time with a room-number interpretation, checking the information type as well as the digit.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Sara and Ruby confirm the time of the next walk after finishing the current one.

difficultyFit.evidence: The load was reduced to time, six and at; seven is deferred.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Six appears in a schedule, dialogue, pronunciation focus and hidden response for different purposes.

transferQuality.evidence: Reading a simple schedule extends earlier label/number reading into time.

overallCoherence.evidence: The Lesson has one communicative job: understand and state the next walk time.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review only. Activity order is more varied and help/feedback paths are present, but no real learner, microphone, timing or retention test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio still requires perceptual/prosody review with human listeners.
Hidden-answer retrieval remains bounded and cannot certify open-ended language ability.
resolvedFindings: The load was reduced to time, six and at; seven is deferred.
Reading a simple schedule extends earlier label/number reading into time.
The Lesson has one communicative job: understand and state the next walk time.
Persian retrieval instruction was normalized from جزء to بخش without changing the learning task.
